posts.preview:
Serve or Sit for Week 5: the lineup calls you are stuck on, from Thursday night to the coin flips. KC and CAR are on bye.

Jacoby Brissett is up to QB8 for me.

Jalen Hurts falls outside my top 12.

Let's get to it.
#BirdGang #FlyEaglesFly

Wednesday's practice reports are in, and the Week 5 injury list got longer.

Lamar Jackson missed practice.

Both Chicago backs sat.

Jayden Daniels practiced in full.
#RavensFlock #DaBears #RaiseHail

The Week 5 Menu is up. KC and CAR are on bye, two quarterbacks climb into the top four, and a receiver with 30 targets in two games jumps into the top 10.

Jared Goff
Matthew Stafford
Michael Wilson

Let's get into it.
#OnePride #RamsHouse #BirdGang

Week 4 broke four backfields, so the waiver wire is stocked with running backs again.

The first claim is Kyle Monangai, who took 30 carries after Chicago benched Swift. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent of FAAB. Let's look into it.
#DaBears

Lane Johnson retired Tuesday, four games into his 14th year.

Philadelphia plays JAX in London without its right tackle, top back, top receiver or top tight end.

Will Shipley is the last healthy back. Claim him, 10 to 15 percent.

Let's dive in.
#FlyEaglesFly #DUUUVAL

Ja'Marr Chase is in the concussion protocol, and Joe Burrow just threw 54 times. That is the best buy of the week.

Trade for him; offer a WR2 and an RB2. Let's get to it.
#WhoDey

Michael Wilson has 30 targets in his last two games. The stove's on in Arizona, and he is the biggest riser of Week 4.

WR44 rest of season for me. Trade for him; offer a bench WR3. Let's get into it.
#BirdGang

Tank Bigsby needs core muscle surgery and heads to IR for about six weeks. Drop him.

Saquon Barkley still waits on Wednesday's update before London.

Will Shipley is the only other Eagles back. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.

Let's look into it.
#FlyEaglesFly

Kansas City won @LV and lost two receivers doing it.

Rashee Rice hurt his hamstring.

Tyquan Thornton dislocated his ankle.

Monitor both.

Week 4's leftovers run from there through every game Sunday played.

Let's dive in.
#ChiefsKingdom #RaiderNation

Saturday's notes are about who sits Sunday and who gets the work, team by team.

Keenan Allen is ruled out for London with the groin.

Josh Downs is WR15 for me @WAS, a WR2.

Let's dive in.
#ForTheShoe #RaiseHail

Friday's notes are about usage: who earned the snaps and routes this week, team by team.

Denzel Boston ran 92 percent of Cleveland's routes Thursday night. Trade for him now; offer a bench WR.

Let's get into it.
#DawgPound

Friday's final injury reports are in. Eleven fantasy players are out for Week 4, nobody is doubtful and eight are questionable.

Jadarian Price is out for Seattle. Emanuel Wilson moves up to RB31 for me, a low-end RB3.

Every team, every pivot. Let's dive in.
#Seahawks

Jayden Daniels is out for Sunday's London game.

Marcus Mariota starts again for Washington, a streamer for me this week.
Let's get to it.
#RaiseHail

Breece Hall is out Sunday at CHI with the quad, Jets coach Aaron Glenn said Friday.

Braelon Allen takes the backfield and is RB21 for me this week.

Let's dive in.
#JetUp

Thursday night lineups lock at 8:15 PM ET. Steelers at Browns, a 38.5 total, Rico Dowdle out and Cleveland's center out. Jaylen Warren is a top-10 back for me. Let's go.
#HereWeGo #DawgPound

On the Line for Week 4, the calls you are stuck on.

Up: Jeremiyah Love, RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 after 64 percent of the snaps as the lead.

Down: Omarion Hampton, RB20 on the Menu and a sit; 42 percent of the snaps, 1 target.

Let's get into it.
#BirdGang #BoltUp

Three New England calls change before Sunday at BUF. Drake Maye comes off the QB1 line, TreVeyon Henderson comes out of the flex, and Mack Hollins, not Romeo Doubs, is the A.J. Brown pivot. Let's look into it. #NEPats #BillsMafia
Rico Dowdle is out for Thursday night at CLE. Toe, walking boot, no practice all week. Jaylen Warren is a start as an RB1 in PPR. Let's get to it. #HereWeGo #DawgPound

Week 4 Menu is up. Three quarterbacks and five lead backs are off the menu, Jaylen Warren is a top-10 back Thursday with Dowdle on two missed practices, and Jayden Daniels sits outside the top 24 until he practices. Start Warren. Let's look into it. #HereWeGo #RaiseHail
De'Von Achane tore his ACL Sunday vs KC and the Dolphins put him on IR Monday. His season is over. Ollie Gordon II is the Miami back to buy in PPR. Let's get to it. #PhinsUp
Baker Mayfield dislocated his right thumb Sunday and Todd Bowles says he is out at least three weeks. Undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels starts vs GB. Hold Mayfield. Let's dive in. #GoBucs

Three backfields broke in Week 3, and the waiver wire is stocked with running backs. The first dollar goes to Ollie Gordon II, who took 84 percent of Miami's snaps after Achane's ACL. Claim him, 20 to 30 percent of FAAB. Let's get into it. #PhinsUp
Chris Olave has 36 targets in three games and one touchdown. The box score hasn't caught up to the usage, and that gap is your buying window. Trade for him today. Let's get to it. #Saints
Rashee Rice's targets went 2, then 6, then 9. The stove's on in Kansas City and he is the top name in this week's usage read. Trade for him before his price catches up. Let's dive in. #ChiefsKingdom
